title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
title_zh: AnyGameRenderer：跨游戏的实体一致性生成式渲染与实体级基准测试

paragraphs.en: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity’s position and timing intact. Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners. AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input. It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame. We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses ∼ \sim 10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection. To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9% to 62.9%, missed count changes fall from 34.7% to 21.3%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.
paragraphs.zh: AI 编程智能体现在可以在几分钟内构建出小型可玩游戏，但结果通常看起来像程序员美术：灰色的方块占位、彩色的几何图元以及扁平的语义色块。 我们提出 AnyGameRenderer，这是一种视频到视频的生成式渲染器，能将此类画面转化为具备角色、运动细节和特效的高质量视觉效果。 在整个过程中，它完整保留布局、摄像机以及每个实体的位置和时序。 我们的 AnyGameRenderer 能够泛化到智能体构建的多种游戏类型，例如塔防、自动战斗、俯视角幸存者、回合制战斗、卡丁车竞速和人群跑酷。 AnyGameRenderer 以普通视频作为其游戏状态输入，无需引擎 G-buffer、逐对象类别标签或低多边形代理等复杂表示。 灰色方块占位、彩色图元、语义图和线框图均可作为输入。 它还能保持实体对应关系：群体数量保持正确，实体在正确的帧上出现和消失。 我们通过对 MiniMax-H3 ref2va 进行 LoRA 微调来实现 AnyGameRenderer，该模型是一个 33B 的参考视频条件化视频生成模型。 训练使用约 1 万条来自三个来源的配对片段：(i) 来自 38 款智能体制作游戏的多流渲染数据；(ii) 来自 Unreal Engine 的双流渲染数据，其中程序化控制人群、数量变化和实体缩放；以及 (iii) 真实游戏录像，通过 3D 框检测重建配对。 为了评估实体对应关系，我们提出了一个实体级基准，包含 59 个保留测试用例和 753 个实体，并对照真值框进行评分。 与基础模型相比，AnyGameRenderer 更好地保持了实体对应关系：时间匹配率从 50.9% 提升至 62.9%，漏检的数量变化从 34.7% 降至 21.3%，被幻觉生成或未被渲染的实体也更少。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents and game-creation tools can now turn a one-paragraph prompt into a playable game in minutes, complete with game logic, physics, camera, win conditions, and working HUD [ 6 ] . What they cannot produce is good art. The output usually contains gray boxes, colored cylinders, and cones on flat-shaded ground. Human studios spend months replacing this kind of “programmer art” through modeling, texturing, and lighting. Splitting a game into an engine that manages state and a generative model that renders pixels has quickly become a common idea. Concurrent systems such as CWM [ 7 ] , PWM [ 14 ] , Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 31 ] , StreamRender-H3 [ 28 ] , Marionette [ 25 ] , and SolarRenderer [ 32 ] all adopt it in some form. We do not argue for this setting. Instead, we build a rendering layer that is more general in what it accepts and more faithful in what it keeps.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , AnyGameRenderer takes a crude gameplay recording and a text prompt (optionally with a style anchor image), and outputs the same gameplay re-rendered in the prompted style, frame-aligned with the input. It adds characters, motion detail, and effects, while keeping the layout, camera, and every entity’s position and timing. This brings two practical benefits. A game can easily switch to a new visual style by changing only the prompt. It also makes vibe gaming faster, since a game only needs code and a blockout, without modeling, texturing or animation.
paragraphs.zh: 如图1所示，AnyGameRenderer 接收一段粗糙的游戏录屏和一个文本提示（可选附带一张风格锚点图像），输出以提示风格重新渲染的同一段游戏画面，并与输入逐帧对齐。 它会增加角色、动作细节和特效，同时保持布局、镜头以及每个实体的位置和时间不变。 这带来了两个实际的好处。 游戏只需更改提示，就能轻松切换到新的视觉风格。 这也让氛围游戏（vibe gaming）更快，因为游戏只需要代码和一个白模（blockout），无需建模、贴图或动画。

paragraphs.en: There are three properties that set AnyGameRenderer apart. (1) It generalizes across genres. Prior and concurrent works are demonstrated mainly on third-person, first-person, or driving footage, with limited coverage of the genres that agents actually produce. As illustrated in Figure 1 , AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres, including tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, crowd runners, arena survival, co-op games, and shooters. In addition, it accepts diverse input types, including gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, wireframes, and coarse mockup.
paragraphs.zh: AnyGameRenderer 有三个使其与众不同的特性。 （1）它能够跨游戏类型泛化。 已有的先行工作与同期工作主要在第三人称、第一人称或驾驶画面上进行演示，对智能体实际产生的游戏类型覆盖有限。 如图 1 所示，AnyGameRenderer 可跨多种游戏类型泛化，包括塔防、自动战斗、俯视角幸存者、回合制战斗、卡丁车竞速、人流跑酷、竞技场生存、合作游戏以及射击游戏。 此外，它接受多样化的输入类型，包括灰盒遮挡体、彩色几何基元、语义图、线框图以及粗略原型模型。

paragraphs.en: (2) It keeps entity correspondence. The hard part of game rendering is bookkeeping: twelve enemies become nine when three die; a reinforcement wave walks in at t = 4.2 t{=}4.2 s; a tiny far-away mob must not dissolve into fog. AnyGameRenderer substantially improves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, entities appear and disappear on the right frame, and fewer small entities are lost. The zero-shot base model often fails here: entities never appear, colored blocks stay unrendered, and characters appear even when they are not in the input.

paragraphs.en: To achieve these properties, we build paired (crude video, styled video) data from three sources. (i) Multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games helps the model generalize across genres and input types. (ii) Two-stream rendering in Unreal Engine uses scenes scripted with same-color groups that change count mid-clip, entity sizes from 20 to 600 px, and frame-aligned appearance and disappearance, teaching the model to keep entity correspondence. (iii) Real gameplay recordings, converted into crude inputs by 3D-box detection, help the model render realistic scenes. Together they yield 10,330 training clips.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现这些特性，我们从三个来源构建配对的（粗糙视频、风格化视频）数据。 （一）来自 38 个智能体制作游戏的多流渲染数据，帮助模型在不同题材和输入类型之间实现泛化。 （二）虚幻引擎中的双流渲染使用以同色组编写的场景脚本，这些同色组会在片段中途改变数量，实体大小从 20 到 600 像素不等，且出现和消失在帧上对齐，从而教会模型保持实体对应关系。 （三）真实游戏录像通过 3D 框检测转换为粗糙输入，帮助模型渲染出逼真的场景。 三者合计产生 10,330 个训练片段。

paragraphs.en: Existing renderers are evaluated at the frame level, with edge agreement, point tracks, or pairwise judges, which cannot tell whether each entity is rendered correctly. We therefore design an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, each annotated with ground-truth boxes, and evaluate it with four metrics. Temporal match measures whether each entity appears and disappears on time; position match measures whether it stays at the right place; unrendered rate measures how often crude input blocks are left unrendered; and hallucination rate measures how often the output contains entities that do not exist in the input. Compared with the zero-shot base, AnyGameRenderer raises temporal match from 50.9% to 62.9% and position match from 57.1% to 61.9%, and lowers the unrendered rate from 4.1% to 2.9% and the hallucination rate from 52.1% to 46.0%.

paragraphs.en: Early work uses large language models to generate game content such as levels and rules. MarioGPT [ 33 ] generates Super Mario Bros. levels from text, Word2World [ 27 ] turns stories into playable 2D tile worlds, and LLMGG [ 12 ] generates game rules and levels in the Video Game Description Language. Multi-agent frameworks such as GameGPT [ 5 ] split game development into roles that collaborate on a full project. More recently, coding agents build complete games end-to-end. Recursive Game Creator [ 6 ] iterates designer, builder, player and reviewer roles over HTML and Godot projects; OpenGame [ 16 ] is an open-source agentic framework for web games across genres such as action and tower defense. While these systems produce working game logic, their visuals are usually limited to simple shapes and placeholder assets, far from the art quality of commercial games.
paragraphs.zh: 早期工作使用大型语言模型来生成关卡和规则等游戏内容。 MarioGPT [ 33 ] 从文本生成《超级马里奥兄弟》关卡，Word2World [ 27 ] 将故事转化为可玩的2D瓦片世界，LLMGG [ 12 ] 在Video Game Description语言中生成游戏规则和关卡。 诸如GameGPT [ 5 ]之类的多智能体框架将游戏开发拆分为多个角色，在一个完整项目中协同工作。 最近，编程智能体可以端到端地构建完整的游戏。 Recursive Game Creator [ 6 ] 在HTML和Godot项目上迭代设计师、构建者、玩家和评审者等角色；OpenGame [ 16 ] 是一个开源的智能体框架，用于涵盖动作和塔防等类型的网页游戏。 虽然这些系统能够产出可运行的游戏逻辑，但其视觉表现通常局限于简单形状和占位素材，远不及商业游戏的美术质量。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work replaces the game engine altogether: an autoregressive video model, conditioned on player actions, generates the next frames. Examples include Genie [ 3 , 29 , 1 ] , GameNGen [ 35 ] , Oasis [ 8 ] , MineWorld [ 10 ] , GameGen-X [ 4 ] , GameFactory [ 40 ] , Hunyuan-GameCraft [ 17 , 34 ] , the Matrix-Game line [ 11 , 36 , 9 ] , and Yume [ 24 , 23 ] . These models are strong simulators but hard to control in the ways a game needs: exact entity counts, scripted events, and rules that hold for minutes. Long-horizon memory [ 38 , 39 , 37 , 21 ] reduces drift but does not make the world programmable.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线则完全取代游戏引擎：一个以玩家操作为条件的自回归视频模型来生成后续帧。 相关工作包括 Genie [ 3 , 29 , 1 ] 、GameNGen [ 35 ] 、Oasis [ 8 ] 、MineWorld [ 10 ] 、GameGen-X [ 4 ] 、GameFactory [ 40 ] 、Hunyuan-GameCraft [ 17 , 34 ] 、Matrix-Game 系列 [ 11 , 36 , 9 ] 以及 Yume [ 24 , 23 ] 。 这些模型是强大的模拟器，但难以按游戏所需的方式进行控制：例如精确的实体数量、脚本化事件，以及能够持续数分钟保持有效的规则。 长时程记忆 [ 38 , 39 , 37 , 21 ] 可以减少漂移，但并不能让这个世界变得可编程。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work keeps the engine in charge of game state and uses a generative model only to render pixels. Neural forward rendering from G-buffers [ 18 , 2 , 41 , 22 ] and earlier generative world renderers [ 15 , 19 ] follow this split, but require engine-exact inputs. Several concurrent systems extend it to crude inputs that a game or an agent can produce cheaply. CWM [ 7 ] lets a coding agent maintain world state and renders a 12-class proxy video with a MiniMax-H3 LoRA. PWM [ 14 ] converts real AAA recordings into state-augmented 3D oriented boxes and renders them with a structured spatial ControlNet on a frozen backbone. Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 31 ] renders low-poly engine proxies in real time with a distilled causal DiT. StreamRender-H3 [ 28 ] streams a 13-class semantic map into video. SolarRenderer [ 32 ] trains a control LoRA on a frozen MiniMax-H3 with six types of structural video, passes them without type labels, and generalizes to structure types unseen in training; it also renders in four steps and supports streaming.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的工作让引擎负责游戏状态，仅使用生成模型来渲染像素。 基于 G-buffer 的神经前向渲染 [ 18 , 2 , 41 , 22 ] 以及早期的生成式世界渲染器 [ 15 , 19 ] 遵循这种划分，但需要与引擎完全一致的输入。 一些并行出现的系统将其扩展到游戏或智能体可以低成本生成的粗糙输入。 CWM [ 7 ] 让一个编码智能体维护世界状态，并使用 MiniMax-H3 LoRA 渲染 12 类代理视频。 PWM [ 14 ] 将真实的 AAA 游戏录像转换为带状态的增强型 3D 朝向框，并在冻结主干上使用结构化空间 ControlNet 进行渲染。 Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 31 ] 使用蒸馏后的因果 DiT 实时渲染低多边形引擎代理。 StreamRender-H3 [ 28 ] 将 13 类语义图流式转化为视频。 SolarRenderer [ 32 ] 在冻结的 MiniMax-H3 上用六种结构化视频训练控制 LoRA，在传递时无需类型标签，并能泛化到训练中未见过的结构类型；它还能以四步完成渲染并支持流式处理。

paragraphs.en: AnyGameRenderer differs from these systems in three ways. First, they are demonstrated mainly on realistic third-person, driving, or a few self-built 3D scenes; our method generalizes across a wide range of genres, including tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, crowd runners, arena survival, co-op games, and shooters. Second, many of them rely on a fixed intermediate representation, while we take plain video. Third, none of them measures entity-level correspondence. Frame-level metrics barely change when a small entity is missing or a group arrives late, and edge agreement even rewards leaving crude blocks unrendered. We make correspondence, including the count, timing and position of every entity, the main target of both training data and evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Let V in ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 V_{\mathrm{in}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} be a crude gameplay clip and c c be a text prompt describing the target style and what each crude entity represents. AnyGameRenderer produces V out V_{\mathrm{out}} of the same length and resolution such that (i) camera, layout, and timing match V in V_{\mathrm{in}} frame by frame; (ii) every crude entity becomes its finished counterpart at the same position, apparent size, and heading, appearing and disappearing on the same frames; and (iii) appearance, including materials, lighting, character design, and environment, follows c c and an optional anchor image I a I_{\mathrm{a}} .
paragraphs.zh: 设 V_in ∈ ℝ^{T×H×W×3} 为一段粗糙的游戏片段，c 为描述目标风格以及每个粗糙实体所代表内容的文本提示。 AnyGameRenderer 生成与输入长度和分辨率相同的 V_out，使得：(i) 摄像机、布局与时机逐帧匹配 V_in；(ii) 每个粗糙实体在相同位置、表观尺寸和朝向上变为其成品对应物，并在相同的帧上出现和消失；以及 (iii) 外观（包括材质、光照、角色设计和环境）遵循 c 和可选的锚点图像 I_a。

paragraphs.en: We build on the ref2va mode of MiniMax-H3 [ 26 ] , which edits a reference video according to a text prompt. We pass the crude clip as <Video 1> and describe the target rendering in the prompt, so any crude input works. The model runs at 24 fps up to 768p. We disable the audio loss in training and discard audio at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MiniMax-H3 [26] 的 ref2va 模式基础上进行构建，该模式根据文本提示对参考视频进行编辑。 我们将粗剪片段作为 <Video 1> 传入，并在提示中描述目标渲染效果，因此任何粗剪输入均可使用。 该模型以 24 fps 的帧率运行，分辨率最高可达 768p。 我们在训练中禁用音频损失，并在推理时丢弃音频。

sents.en: We build on the ref2va mode of MiniMax-H3 [ 26 ] , which edits a reference video according to a text prompt.
sents.zh: 我们在 MiniMax-H3 [26] 的 ref2va 模式基础上进行构建，该模式根据文本提示对参考视频进行编辑。

sents.en: We pass the crude clip as <Video 1> and describe the target rendering in the prompt, so any crude input works.
sents.zh: 我们将粗剪片段作为 <Video 1> 传入，并在提示中描述目标渲染效果，因此任何粗剪输入均可使用。

sents.en: The model runs at 24 fps up to 768p.
sents.zh: 该模型以 24 fps 的帧率运行，分辨率最高可达 768p。

sents.en: We disable the audio loss in training and discard audio at inference.
sents.zh: 我们在训练中禁用音频损失，并在推理时丢弃音频。

paragraphs.en: Each sample has three conditions: 1) the crude clip as reference video <Video 1> ; 2) a six-segment structured caption ( Section 3.2 ); and 3) an optional anchor image. During training, the anchor is the target’s first frame; at inference, it serves as a style reference or is omitted. The crude clip fixes the structure, while the caption and anchor set the style. To render the same clip in a new style, we only change the prompt or the anchor.
paragraphs.zh: 每个样本包含三个条件：1）作为参考视频的原始片段 <Video 1>；2）六段式结构化描述（见 3.2 节）；3）可选的锚点图像。 在训练时，锚点是目标视频的首帧；在推理时，它作为风格参考或被省略。 原始片段固定结构，而描述和锚点设定风格。 要以新风格渲染同一片段，我们只需更改提示词或锚点。

sents.en: Each sample has three conditions: 1) the crude clip as reference video <Video 1> ; 2) a six-segment structured caption ( Section 3.2 ); and 3) an optional anchor image.
sents.zh: 每个样本包含三个条件：1）作为参考视频的原始片段 <Video 1>；2）六段式结构化描述（见 3.2 节）；3）可选的锚点图像。

sents.en: During training, the anchor is the target’s first frame; at inference, it serves as a style reference or is omitted.
sents.zh: 在训练时，锚点是目标视频的首帧；在推理时，它作为风格参考或被省略。

sents.en: The crude clip fixes the structure, while the caption and anchor set the style.
sents.zh: 原始片段固定结构，而描述和锚点设定风格。

sents.en: To render the same clip in a new style, we only change the prompt or the anchor.
sents.zh: 要以新风格渲染同一片段，我们只需更改提示词或锚点。

paragraphs.en: We train a LoRA [ 13 ] of rank 128 on all transformer blocks with the standard flow-matching objective [ 20 ] , keeping the base weights frozen. All reported results use 20-step Euler sampling on base + + LoRA.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在所有 transformer 块上，以标准的流匹配目标 [20] 训练一个秩为 128 的 LoRA [13]，并保持基础权重冻结。 所有报告的结果均使用在 base + + LoRA 上的 20 步 Euler 采样。

sents.en: We train a LoRA [ 13 ] of rank 128 on all transformer blocks with the standard flow-matching objective [ 20 ] , keeping the base weights frozen.
sents.zh: 我们在所有 transformer 块上，以标准的流匹配目标 [20] 训练一个秩为 128 的 LoRA [13]，并保持基础权重冻结。

sents.en: All reported results use 20-step Euler sampling on base + + LoRA.
sents.zh: 所有报告的结果均使用在 base + + LoRA 上的 20 步 Euler 采样。

paragraphs.en: We keep the base model’s six-segment format ( subject_definitions , summary , retention_analysis , detailed_description , overall_soundscape , non_diegetic_music ) and follow four rules, which we call the correspondence contract.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留基础模型的六段式格式（ subject_definitions 、 summary 、 retention_analysis 、 detailed_description 、 overall_soundscape 、 non_diegetic_music ），并遵循四条规则，我们称之为对应契约（correspondence contract）。

paragraphs.en: Each subject is defined as the real entity, and the crude input is named as its representation, e.g., “ every blue ellipsoid in <Video 1> is one raccoon-like orchard raider, and the whole blue group is a group of identical ones .” The color-to-identity mapping is set per clip, groups are described at class level with explicit statements that they exist.
paragraphs.zh: 每个主体被定义为真实实体，而粗略输入被称为其表征，例如：“<视频 1> 中的每一个蓝色椭球体都是一个类似浣熊的果园掠夺者，整个蓝色群体是一组相同的个体。”颜色到身份的映射按片段设置，群体在类级别进行描述，并明确说明它们是存在的。

paragraphs.en: This segment declares position, apparent size, timing, and head count as preserved exactly, and leaves appearance to the prompt. It also describes empty space positively: “areas empty in <Video 1> stay empty; no character is added that has no primitive in <Video 1> .”
paragraphs.zh: 该片段声明位置、表观大小、时机和头部数量被完全保留，而将外观留给提示词处理。 它还对空白区域进行了正向描述：「<Video 1> 中为空的区域保持为空；不添加任何在 <Video 1> 中没有对应基元的角色。」

sents.en: This segment declares position, apparent size, timing, and head count as preserved exactly, and leaves appearance to the prompt.
sents.zh: 该片段声明位置、表观大小、时机和头部数量被完全保留，而将外观留给提示词处理。

sents.en: It also describes empty space positively: “areas empty in <Video 1> stay empty; no character is added that has no primitive in <Video 1> .”
sents.zh: 它还对空白区域进行了正向描述：「<Video 1> 中为空的区域保持为空；不添加任何在 <Video 1> 中没有对应基元的角色。」

paragraphs.en: The base model has no negative prompt, and negative phrasing tends to produce what it names (“no HUD” reliably produces a HUD). All captions are therefore written as positive statements.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型没有负面提示词的概念，否定式的表述往往会产生其所命名的内容（"no HUD"（无 HUD）总是可靠地生成一个 HUD）。 因此所有描述都写成肯定式陈述。

sents.en: The base model has no negative prompt, and negative phrasing tends to produce what it names (“no HUD” reliably produces a HUD).
sents.zh: 基础模型没有负面提示词的概念，否定式的表述往往会产生其所命名的内容（"no HUD"（无 HUD）总是可靠地生成一个 HUD）。

sents.en: All captions are therefore written as positive statements.
sents.zh: 因此所有描述都写成肯定式陈述。

paragraphs.en: Captions are generated automatically from engine metadata and detection results, not written by hand. Each caption lists every character that may appear in the game, even if some never show up in the clip. We keep this noise on purpose: it teaches the model to decide what exists from the video, not from the text. As a result, the model rarely adds characters that are named in the caption but missing from the input.
paragraphs.zh: 字幕由引擎元数据和检测结果自动生成，而非人工编写。 每条字幕都会列出游戏中可能出现的所有角色，即使某些角色从未在片段中出现。 我们刻意保留这种噪声：它教会模型根据视频而非文本来判断什么东西存在。 因此，该模型很少添加那些在字幕中被提及但输入中缺失的角色。

sents.en: Captions are generated automatically from engine metadata and detection results, not written by hand.
sents.zh: 字幕由引擎元数据和检测结果自动生成，而非人工编写。

sents.en: Each caption lists every character that may appear in the game, even if some never show up in the clip.
sents.zh: 每条字幕都会列出游戏中可能出现的所有角色，即使某些角色从未在片段中出现。

sents.zh: 因此，该模型很少添加那些在字幕中被提及但输入中缺失的角色。

paragraphs.en: All sources are resampled to 124-frame clips at 24 fps (5.17 s) and 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 , with the target’s first frame as the anchor and a silent 32 kHz audio track. Latents and text embeddings are cached once per source.
paragraphs.zh: 所有来源均重采样为 24 fps（5.17 秒）下 124 帧的片段，分辨率 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768，以目标的首帧为锚点，并配备一条静音的 32 kHz 音轨。 潜变量和文本嵌入对每个来源仅缓存一次。

sents.en: All sources are resampled to 124-frame clips at 24 fps (5.17 s) and 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 , with the target’s first frame as the anchor and a silent 32 kHz audio track.
sents.zh: 所有来源均重采样为 24 fps（5.17 秒）下 124 帧的片段，分辨率 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768，以目标的首帧为锚点，并配备一条静音的 32 kHz 音轨。

sents.en: Latents and text embeddings are cached once per source.
sents.zh: 潜变量和文本嵌入对每个来源仅缓存一次。

paragraphs.en: We train a rank-128 LoRA on all blocks with a global batch size of 16. The learning rate warms up over 100 steps and then follows a cosine decay, with a peak between 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} and 2.8 × 10 − 5 2.8{\times}10^{-5} ; weight decay is 0.01. We use bf16 precision, gradient checkpointing, and block swapping, while FlashAttention-3 [ 30 ] speeds up each step by about 30%. Training runs on 16 NVIDIA H200 GPUs (141 GB). Each step takes about 129 s, and three epochs over all 10,330 training clips take about 48 hours.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在所有模块上训练一个秩为 128 的 LoRA，全局批大小为 16。 学习率在 100 步内预热，然后按余弦衰减，峰值介于 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} 和 2.8 × 10 − 5 2.8{\times}10^{-5} 之间；权重衰减为 0.01。 我们使用 bf16 精度、梯度检查点和模块交换，同时 FlashAttention-3 [ 30 ] 将每一步的速度提升约 30%。 训练在 16 块 NVIDIA H200 GPU（141 GB）上运行。 每一步约需 129 秒，对全部 10,330 个训练片段进行三个 epoch 的训练约需 48 小时。

sents.en: We train a rank-128 LoRA on all blocks with a global batch size of 16.
sents.zh: 我们在所有模块上训练一个秩为 128 的 LoRA，全局批大小为 16。

sents.en: The learning rate warms up over 100 steps and then follows a cosine decay, with a peak between 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} and 2.8 × 10 − 5 2.8{\times}10^{-5} ; weight decay is 0.01.
sents.zh: 学习率在 100 步内预热，然后按余弦衰减，峰值介于 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} 和 2.8 × 10 − 5 2.8{\times}10^{-5} 之间；权重衰减为 0.01。

sents.en: We use bf16 precision, gradient checkpointing, and block swapping, while FlashAttention-3 [ 30 ] speeds up each step by about 30%.
sents.zh: 我们使用 bf16 精度、梯度检查点和模块交换，同时 FlashAttention-3 [ 30 ] 将每一步的速度提升约 30%。

sents.en: Training runs on 16 NVIDIA H200 GPUs (141 GB).
sents.zh: 训练在 16 块 NVIDIA H200 GPU（141 GB）上运行。

sents.en: Each step takes about 129 s, and three epochs over all 10,330 training clips take about 48 hours.
sents.zh: 每一步约需 129 秒，对全部 10,330 个训练片段进行三个 epoch 的训练约需 48 小时。

paragraphs.en: We use a LoRA multiplier of 1.0 for in-domain inputs and styles. For out-of-domain text-only styles (no anchor image, and a style unseen in training), a multiplier of 0.7 recovers the zero-shot visual quality while keeping the correspondence gains. We recommend it as the default for open-ended styling.
paragraphs.zh: 对于域内输入和风格，我们使用 1.0 的 LoRA 乘数。 对于域外纯文本风格（没有锚点图像，且该风格在训练中未见过的），乘数取 0.7 可以在保持对应性收益的同时恢复零样本视觉质量。 我们建议将其作为开放式风格化的默认设置。

sents.en: We use a LoRA multiplier of 1.0 for in-domain inputs and styles.
sents.zh: 对于域内输入和风格，我们使用 1.0 的 LoRA 乘数。

sents.en: For out-of-domain text-only styles (no anchor image, and a style unseen in training), a multiplier of 0.7 recovers the zero-shot visual quality while keeping the correspondence gains.
sents.zh: 对于域外纯文本风格（没有锚点图像，且该风格在训练中未见过的），乘数取 0.7 可以在保持对应性收益的同时恢复零样本视觉质量。

sents.en: We recommend it as the default for open-ended styling.
sents.zh: 我们建议将其作为开放式风格化的默认设置。

paragraphs.en: We build (crude video, styled video) pairs from three sources: multi-stream rendering data from agent-made games covers different genres and input types; two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine targets entity correspondence; and real gameplay recordings add realistic layouts, cameras, and motion. In every pair, the crude and styled videos share the same camera and layout and are frame-aligned by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个来源构建（粗糙视频，风格化视频）配对：来自智能体制作游戏的多流渲染数据涵盖不同的游戏类型和输入方式；来自虚幻引擎的双流渲染数据以实体对应为目标；真实游戏录屏则增加了真实的布局、摄像机和运动。 在每一对视频中，粗糙视频与风格化视频共享相同的摄像机和布局，并且在构造上就是逐帧对齐的。

sents.en: We build (crude video, styled video) pairs from three sources: multi-stream rendering data from agent-made games covers different genres and input types; two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine targets entity correspondence; and real gameplay recordings add realistic layouts, cameras, and motion.
sents.zh: 我们从三个来源构建（粗糙视频，风格化视频）配对：来自智能体制作游戏的多流渲染数据涵盖不同的游戏类型和输入方式；来自虚幻引擎的双流渲染数据以实体对应为目标；真实游戏录屏则增加了真实的布局、摄像机和运动。

sents.en: In every pair, the crude and styled videos share the same camera and layout and are frame-aligned by construction.
sents.zh: 在每一对视频中，粗糙视频与风格化视频共享相同的摄像机和布局，并且在构造上就是逐帧对齐的。

paragraphs.en: Our multi-stream rendering data comprises 38 agent-made games, covering shooters, survivors, tower defense, kart racing, arena, and co-op designs. This source contributes 3,221 clips. Each clip has five aligned passes: the target render; a primitive pass, where the scene is a gray blockout and characters are simple geometric shapes; a coarse pass, with a more detailed blockout and low-poly clay figures; a 12-class semantic map; and depth. Each clip also comes with an anchor image, a caption, and 3D boxes. We train on the pair of primitive and target.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的多流渲染数据包含 38 个由智能体制作的游戏，涵盖射击、生存、塔防、卡丁车竞速、竞技场以及合作类设计。 该数据源贡献了 3,221 个片段。 每个片段包含五个对齐的通道：目标渲染；原始通道，其中场景为灰色块状布局，角色为简单几何形状；粗糙通道，具有更细致的块状布局和低多边形黏土人模型；一张 12 类语义图；以及深度图。 每个片段还附带一张锚点图像、一个描述文本和 3D 边界框。 我们在原始通道与目标通道的配对上进行训练。

sents.en: Our multi-stream rendering data comprises 38 agent-made games, covering shooters, survivors, tower defense, kart racing, arena, and co-op designs.
sents.zh: 我们的多流渲染数据包含 38 个由智能体制作的游戏，涵盖射击、生存、塔防、卡丁车竞速、竞技场以及合作类设计。

sents.en: Each clip also comes with an anchor image, a caption, and 3D boxes.
sents.zh: 每个片段还附带一张锚点图像、一个描述文本和 3D 边界框。

sents.en: We train on the pair of primitive and target.
sents.zh: 我们在原始通道与目标通道的配对上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Each Unreal Engine scene uses two-stream rendering: it is rendered from the same simulation and camera as a gray blockout with colored blocks for characters and as a full render. The protagonist is always blue, and other characters use a six-color set.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 Unreal Engine 场景采用双流渲染：同一仿真和相机会渲染出两个版本，一个是带有彩色方块表示角色的灰色块状模型版本，另一个是完整渲染版本。 主角始终为蓝色，其他角色使用一组六种颜色。

sents.en: Each Unreal Engine scene uses two-stream rendering: it is rendered from the same simulation and camera as a gray blockout with colored blocks for characters and as a full render.
sents.zh: 每个 Unreal Engine 场景采用双流渲染：同一仿真和相机会渲染出两个版本，一个是带有彩色方块表示角色的灰色块状模型版本，另一个是完整渲染版本。

sents.en: The protagonist is always blue, and other characters use a six-color set.
sents.zh: 主角始终为蓝色，其他角色使用一组六种颜色。

paragraphs.en: Rather than collecting generic gameplay, we script scenes around the zero-shot failures (see examples in Figure 3 ) to ensure entity correspondence:
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有收集通用的游戏对局数据，而是围绕零样本失败案例（见图 3 中的示例）设计脚本化场景，以确保实体对应关系：

paragraphs.en: Count changes in same-color groups. Groups of 2 to 20 characters walk in, spawn, walk out, or despawn during the clip, in dense clusters, columns, or scattered formations. This targets crowds left as unrendered blocks and entities that appear late or never.
paragraphs.zh: 统计同色组的数量变化。 由 2 到 20 个角色组成的组在片段中以密集集群、纵队或分散队形走入、生成、走出或消失。 这针对的是保留为未渲染方块的人群以及出现较晚或从不出现的实体。

sents.en: Count changes in same-color groups.
sents.zh: 统计同色组的数量变化。

paragraphs.en: Following the reconstruction approach in PWM [ 14 ] , we convert real gameplay recordings of combat, driving, and pedestrian scenes into crude inputs. We detect 3D bounding boxes in each frame and render them over a checkerboard ground as proxies of varied shapes: solid boxes, wireframe boxes, cylinders, and upright ellipsoids, with about 800 clips per shape. The original recording is the target, and captions come from the detection labels plus one sentence describing the environment. This source adds real-world scenes, with realistic camera work and vehicle and pedestrian motion. It contributes 3,199 clips.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循PWM[14]中的重建方法，我们将战斗、驾驶和行人场景的真实游戏录像转换为粗糙输入。 我们在每帧中检测三维边界框，并将其渲染在棋盘格地面上，作为各种形状的替代物：实心盒、线框盒、圆柱体和直立椭球体，每种形状约有800个片段。 原始录像作为目标，字幕来自检测标签加上一句描述环境的句子。 该数据源增加了真实世界场景，具有逼真的镜头运动以及车辆和行人的动作。 它贡献了3,199个片段。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark contains 59 cases with 753 annotated entities: 11 held-out two-stream rendering cases from Unreal Engine (gray blockouts), 14 real recordings with detected solid boxes, and 34 multi-stream rendering cases from six held-out agent-made games. Each case uses a source clip excluded from training, rendered in a style or with characters not seen in training. All models are run with the same seed, 20 sampling steps, and the same captions.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试包含 59 个用例，共有 753 个标注实体：11 个来自 Unreal Engine 的留出双流渲染用例（灰色灰盒）、14 个带有检测实体框的真实录制，以及 34 个来自六个留出的智能体自制游戏的多流渲染用例。 每个用例均使用未参与训练的源片段，并以训练中未见过的风格或角色进行渲染。 所有模型均使用相同的种子、20 个采样步骤和相同的字幕运行。

paragraphs.en: Input entities are the ground-truth 2D boxes shipped with each crude video; entities that exist for fewer than 12 frames are ignored. In the generated video, we locate characters with SAM3 open-vocabulary segmentation, prompted with the caption’s subject phrases plus generic person and vehicle terms. We remove shadow and reflection detections and link the remaining detections into tracks. In each frame, input boxes and detections are matched with the Hungarian method, and a pair is accepted only if IoU ≥ 0.3 {}\geq 0.3 or the centroid offset is within half the input box size. We report four main metrics, averaged over entities:

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports results on all 59 cases and on each source. Over all cases, our method improves all four main metrics: temporal match rises from 50.9% to 62.9%, position match from 57.1% to 61.9%, the unrendered rate falls from 4.1% to 2.9%, and the hallucination rate falls from 52.1% to 46.0%. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows seven held-out cases. The zero-shot model works well on sparse scenes with clean captions, but on game footage it fails in three ways. First, it leaves crude shapes in the output: blue cubes in an orchard, cyan cylinders in an arena, and a blue cylinder in the grass where an elk should be. Second, it drops the input viewpoint when the style is far from typical game footage, turning a top-down blockout into a frontal anime group shot or a first-person Minecraft-like scene. Third, it adds characters named in the caption that have no block in the input. AnyGameRenderer fixes all three in these cases while keeping the prompted style.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了七个保留测试用例。 零样本模型在字幕干净的稀疏场景上表现良好，但在游戏画面上会出现三种失败。 首先，它会在输出中留下粗糙的形状：果园里的蓝色立方体、竞技场中的青色圆柱体，以及草地上本应是麋鹿的一根蓝色圆柱体。 其次，当风格与典型的游戏画面相差较远时，它会丢弃输入视角，把俯视的方块布局变成正面的动漫群像，或变成第一人称的类 Minecraft 场景。 第三，它会添加字幕中提到但输入中没有对应方块的角色。 AnyGameRenderer 在这些用例中修复了全部三个问题，同时保留了提示词指定的风格。

sents.en: First, it leaves crude shapes in the output: blue cubes in an orchard, cyan cylinders in an arena, and a blue cylinder in the grass where an elk should be.
sents.zh: 首先，它会在输出中留下粗糙的形状：果园里的蓝色立方体、竞技场中的青色圆柱体，以及草地上本应是麋鹿的一根蓝色圆柱体。

sents.en: Second, it drops the input viewpoint when the style is far from typical game footage, turning a top-down blockout into a frontal anime group shot or a first-person Minecraft-like scene.
sents.zh: 其次，当风格与典型的游戏画面相差较远时，它会丢弃输入视角，把俯视的方块布局变成正面的动漫群像，或变成第一人称的类 Minecraft 场景。

sents.en: Third, it adds characters named in the caption that have no block in the input.
sents.zh: 第三，它会添加字幕中提到但输入中没有对应方块的角色。

sents.en: AnyGameRenderer fixes all three in these cases while keeping the prompted style.
sents.zh: AnyGameRenderer 在这些用例中修复了全部三个问题，同时保留了提示词指定的风格。

paragraphs.en: A single checkpoint handles all five genres in our benchmark: first-person shooters, top-down, third-person, crowd, and vehicle games ( Figure 5 ). AnyGameRenderer improves temporal match over the zero-shot model in every genre, with the largest gains on crowd and third-person games. It also lowers the unrendered rate in every genre except crowd games, where both models are already near zero, and improves position match most on vehicle games. The hallucination rate falls on crowd games but rises slightly on top-down and third-person games. Top-down games remain the hardest, with low temporal match for both models.
paragraphs.zh: 单一检查点即可处理我们基准测试中的全部五种类型：第一人称射击、俯视角、第三人称、人群和载具类游戏（图 5）。 AnyGameRenderer 在每种类型上都比零样本模型提升了时间匹配度，其中在人群类和第三人称游戏上的提升最大。 它还降低了除人群类游戏之外所有类型的未渲染率（两种模型在该类型上均已接近零），并在载具类游戏上的位置匹配度提升最多。 幻觉率在人群类游戏上下降，但在俯视角和第三人称游戏上略有上升。 俯视角游戏仍然最难，两种模型在该类型上的时间匹配度都很低。

paragraphs.en: We presented AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns the programmer art of agent-made games into high-quality visuals. We train a single LoRA on MiniMax-H3, using paired data from agent-made games, Unreal Engine’s two-stream rendering, and real gameplay recordings. The resulting checkpoint handles a wide range of genres. It takes plain video as input, from gray blockouts and colored primitives to semantic maps and wireframes. It also keeps entities in sync with the input. On a held-out benchmark, temporal match rises from 50.9% to 62.9%, and missed count changes fall from 34.7% to 21.3%. As coding agents build more and more games, we believe a general renderer that keeps every entity in place will help these games look as good as they play.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AnyGameRenderer，一个视频到视频的生成式渲染器，能把智能体制作游戏中简陋的程序员美术转化为高质量的画面。 我们在 MiniMax-H3 上训练单个 LoRA，使用来自智能体制作游戏、Unreal Engine 双流渲染以及真实游戏录像的成对数据。 由此得到的模型检查点能够应对广泛的题材类型。 它以普通视频作为输入，可以是灰色黑盒原型、彩色几何体、语义图或线框图。 它还能保持实体与输入的同步。 在一个留出基准上，时间匹配率从 50.9% 提升到 62.9%，漏检的数量变化从 34.7% 降到 21.3%。 随着编程智能体制作的游戏越来越多，我们相信一个能让每个实体都保持原位的通用渲染器，将帮助这些游戏拥有与其玩法相称的出色外观。
